<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  xmlns:zeebe="http://camunda.org/schema/zeebe/1.0"
                  id="Definitions_OMS"
                  targetNamespace="http://oms.com/bpmn"
                  exporter="oms-camunda" exporterVersion="1.0.0">

  <!-- ================= Messages (Temporal signals/updates) ================= -->
  <!-- correlationKey = orderId: every external event is routed to the order's
       process instance by its order id, exactly as Temporal signals targeted a
       workflowId of order_<orderId>. -->
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SupportCorrection" name="SupportCorrection">
    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <zeebe:subscription correlationKey="=orderId" />
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
  </bpmn:message>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CapturePayment" name="CapturePayment">
    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <zeebe:subscription correlationKey="=orderId" />
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
  </bpmn:message>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CancelOrder" name="CancelOrder">
    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <zeebe:subscription correlationKey="=orderId" />
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
  </bpmn:message>

  <!-- ================= Errors (thrown by workers) ========================== -->
  <bpmn:error id="Error_InvalidOrder" name="InvalidOrder" errorCode="INVALID_ORDER" />
  <bpmn:error id="Error_InvalidPayment" name="InvalidPayment" errorCode="INVALID_PAYMENT" />

  <bpmn:process id="order-processing" name="Order Processing" isExecutable="true">

    <!-- ======================= Main happy path ============================ -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_start_received</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateReceived" name="Dashboard: ORDER_RECEIVED">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="update-dashboard" />
        <zeebe:taskHeaders>
          <zeebe:header key="status" value="ORDER_RECEIVED" />
        </zeebe:taskHeaders>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_start_received</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_received_validate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ValidateOrder" name="Validate order (Commerce API)">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="validate-order" retries="2147483647" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_received_validate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_catchcorr_validate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_validate_pending</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdatePaymentPending" name="Dashboard: PAYMENT_PENDING">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="update-dashboard" />
        <zeebe:taskHeaders>
          <zeebe:header key="status" value="PAYMENT_PENDING" />
        </zeebe:taskHeaders>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_validate_pending</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_pending_catchpay</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Payment" name="Await CapturePayment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_pending_catchpay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_bnd_catchpay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_catchpay_validatepay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Payment" messageRef="Message_CapturePayment" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ValidatePayment" name="Validate payment RRN">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="validate-payment" retries="5" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_catchpay_validatepay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_validatepay_captured</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateCaptured" name="Dashboard: PAYMENT_CAPTURED">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="update-dashboard" />
        <zeebe:taskHeaders>
          <zeebe:header key="status" value="PAYMENT_CAPTURED" />
        </zeebe:taskHeaders>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_validatepay_captured</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_captured_enrich</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Enrich" name="Enrich with PIM">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="enrich-order" retries="2147483647" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_captured_enrich</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_enrich_publish</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Publish" name="Publish to fulfillment">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="publish-fulfillment" retries="2147483647" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_enrich_publish</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_publish_fulfilled</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateFulfilled" name="Dashboard: FULFILLED">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="update-dashboard" />
        <zeebe:taskHeaders>
          <zeebe:header key="status" value="FULFILLED" />
        </zeebe:taskHeaders>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_publish_fulfilled</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_fulfilled_end</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Done" name="Order fulfilled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_fulfilled_end</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- =================== Correction loop (INVALID_ORDER) ================= -->
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Bnd_InvalidOrder" name="INVALID_ORDER" attachedToRef="Task_ValidateOrder">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_bnd_awaitcorr</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:errorEventDefinition id="EED_InvalidOrder" errorRef="Error_InvalidOrder" />
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AwaitCorrectionStatus" name="Dashboard: AWAITING_CORRECTION">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="update-dashboard" />
        <zeebe:taskHeaders>
          <zeebe:header key="status" value="AWAITING_CORRECTION" />
        </zeebe:taskHeaders>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_bnd_awaitcorr</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_awaitcorr_catchcorr</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Correction" name="Await SupportCorrection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_awaitcorr_catchcorr</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_catchcorr_validate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Correction" messageRef="Message_SupportCorrection" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <!-- =================== Payment loop (INVALID_PAYMENT) ================= -->
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Bnd_InvalidPayment" name="INVALID_PAYMENT" attachedToRef="Task_ValidatePayment">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_bnd_catchpay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:errorEventDefinition id="EED_InvalidPayment" errorRef="Error_InvalidPayment" />
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <!-- ======================= Sequence flows ============================ -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_start_received" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_UpdateReceived" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_received_validate" sourceRef="Task_UpdateReceived" targetRef="Task_ValidateOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_validate_pending" sourceRef="Task_ValidateOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdatePaymentPending" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_pending_catchpay" sourceRef="Task_UpdatePaymentPending" targetRef="Catch_Payment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_catchpay_validatepay" sourceRef="Catch_Payment" targetRef="Task_ValidatePayment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_validatepay_captured" sourceRef="Task_ValidatePayment" targetRef="Task_UpdateCaptured" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_captured_enrich" sourceRef="Task_UpdateCaptured" targetRef="Task_Enrich" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_enrich_publish" sourceRef="Task_Enrich" targetRef="Task_Publish" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_publish_fulfilled" sourceRef="Task_Publish" targetRef="Task_UpdateFulfilled" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_fulfilled_end" sourceRef="Task_UpdateFulfilled" targetRef="EndEvent_Done" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_bnd_awaitcorr" sourceRef="Bnd_InvalidOrder" targetRef="Task_AwaitCorrectionStatus" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_awaitcorr_catchcorr" sourceRef="Task_AwaitCorrectionStatus" targetRef="Catch_Correction" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_catchcorr_validate" sourceRef="Catch_Correction" targetRef="Task_ValidateOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_bnd_catchpay" sourceRef="Bnd_InvalidPayment" targetRef="Catch_Payment" />

    <!-- ============ Cancel: interrupting message event subprocess ========= -->
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Cancel" name="Cancellation" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Cancel" name="CancelOrder" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_cancel_1</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Cancel" messageRef="Message_CancelOrder" />
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateCancelled" name="Dashboard: CANCELLED">
        <bpmn:extensionElements>
          <zeebe:taskDefinition type="update-dashboard" />
          <zeebe:taskHeaders>
            <zeebe:header key="status" value="CANCELLED" />
          </zeebe:taskHeaders>
        </bpmn:extensionElements>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_cancel_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_cancel_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Cancelled" name="Cancelled">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_cancel_2</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TED_Cancel" />
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_cancel_1" sourceRef="Start_Cancel" targetRef="Task_UpdateCancelled" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_cancel_2" sourceRef="Task_UpdateCancelled" targetRef="End_Cancelled" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <!-- ============ TTL: interrupting timer event subprocess (30 days) ===== -->
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_TTL" name="Order TTL (30 days)" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_TTL" name="30-day TTL" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ttl_1</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_TTL">
          <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT720H</bpmn:timeDuration>
        </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpired" name="Dashboard: EXPIRED">
        <bpmn:extensionElements>
          <zeebe:taskDefinition type="update-dashboard" />
          <zeebe:taskHeaders>
            <zeebe:header key="status" value="EXPIRED" />
          </zeebe:taskHeaders>
        </bpmn:extensionElements>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ttl_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ttl_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Expired" name="Expired">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ttl_2</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TED_Expired" />
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ttl_1" sourceRef="Start_TTL" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpired" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ttl_2" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpired" targetRef="End_Expired" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>

  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- ============================= Diagram =============================== -->
